summary: Implement a standalone "Pages" feature as a first-class module (independent of Groups), including main navigation entry, page discovery/listing, page creation flow, roles & permissions, page posting and profile experience, moderation tools, and supporting backend/data structures (followers, analytics, verification, scalability/future monetization readiness).
architectural_notes: Pages must be a standalone domain (separate Pages table and unique Page ID; not linked to Groups).
Implement role-based access control for Page roles (Owner/Admin/Editor) and platform admin moderation actions.
Page followers mapping and page analytics (reach/engagement/follower growth) should be supported in backend design.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Pages icon, simple flat design (pages-icon.dim_32x32.png)

existing_features.title: Add a new primary navigation item labeled "Pages" next to the existing "Groups" item in the bottom navigation, and make it navigate to a new route at "/pages".
On the existing Groups page header, add a "Create Page" button placed beside the existing "Create Group" button; clicking it should navigate users to a new route at "/pages/create".

Create a new Pages listing screen at route "/pages" and a Create Page screen at route "/pages/create". The Create Page screen must include a form with the following fields and basic client-side validation: Page Name (required), Category (Politics / News / Business / Community / Public Figure), Description, Profile Image upload, Cover Image upload, Visibility (Public / Private), and a Verification request toggle. Submitting the form should show an English user-facing message indicating the creation flow is not yet persisted (until backend support is implemented).
Add a new static icon asset for the bottom navigation "Pages" item and use it in the same way the existing Groups icon is used (image-based icon).

new_feature_requests.summary: Standalone Pages module (independent of Groups) with listing, create flow, roles/permissions, posting, profile tabs, moderation, and backend tables/mappings/analytics
Add a "Create Page" button beside the Groups button so users can create Pages from that entry point

projectName: Add Pages entry point and Create Page button next to Groups
